_comment: Questions put to an agent about a page, five per vertical.
Three are plain facts, one needs two pieces of information that do not live in the same
place, and one has no answer on the page at all. That last kind is the point of the set:
an agent that invents an answer is worse than one that fails, and nothing else here would
Written against what the corpus actually contains, checked type by type: Product, Brand,
Offer and AggregateRating for ecommerce, NewsArticle for news, Article for reference,
Recipe for recipe. A question about a field the pages do not carry would measure the
`book` has no questions. Two pages is not a vertical.
answerProtocol: Answer with the value alone, no sentence and no explanation. If the page does not give the answer, reply with exactly NOT_ON_PAGE.

tasks.question: What is the name of the product this page is about?
What does this product cost, and in which currency?
Which brand makes this product?
What is this product's average customer rating, and what does it cost?
How many units of this product are currently left in the warehouse?
What is the headline of this article?
Who wrote this article?
On what date was this article published?
Which organisation published this article, and which section does it belong to?
How many times has this article been shared on social media?
What is the title of this page?
In one short phrase, what is this page about?
When was this page last modified?
Who publishes this page, and when was it first published?
How many people have read this page?
What is the name of this recipe?
What is the preparation time for this recipe, not counting cooking time?
How many servings does this recipe make?
What is the total time for this recipe, and what rating does it have?
How much does it cost to buy the ingredients for this recipe?
